name: Combined proof section: animated stat row + award plaque + Google rating summary
notes: Stacks three proof devices in one section instead of spreading them thin: a stat row (years/reviews/rating/awards, count-up-on-scroll hooks via data-count), a photographed award plaque with a bulleted achievement list, and a Google-rating summary block (real G logo SVG inlined) with an HTML comment marking where to drop in a live Elfsight/Trustindex/Featurable review-widget embed later. Heaviest file in the library — good candidate to split back into 2-3 smaller sections if only one device is needed.
